answer_text: Python 3.14.8 is still the latest Python 3.14 maintenance release. Python 3.14.10 was released on October 25, 2026.

time_sensitivity.reason: Latest maintenance release changes every ~2 months; the answer also contradicts itself by mentioning 3.14.10.

inference.observed: Python 3.14.10 (released Oct. 25, 2026) is the latest 3.14 maintenance release; the 3.14.8 page says it has been superseded by 3.14.10.
inference.rationale: The python.org 3.14.8 page states it was superseded by 3.14.10, and the latest-3.14 page lists 3.14.10 as the current release, so 3.14.8 is no longer the latest.
inference.suggested_rewrite: Python 3.14.8 has been superseded by Python 3.14.10, the tenth maintenance release of 3.14, released Oct. 25, 2026.

time_sensitivity.reason: Release dates and version numbers for Python patch releases may be inaccurate or superseded by newer releases.

inference.observed: The python.org release page for Python 3.14.10 lists the release date as Oct. 25, 2026, and describes it as an expedited security release.
inference.rationale: The official python.org page for 3.14.10 states the release date matches the claim. The PEP 745 schedule lists a different planned date, but that is an earlier expected schedule, and the release page describes an expedited release.
